messages:
Sara (Marketing): ok team, prep for webinar narrative — want a concise latency vs cost story that maps to inbound routing. thinking 3 visuals: 1) p95 latency vs $/1k tokens across model variants, 2) latency distribution + SLA bands, 3) cost impact of caching/batching. thoughts? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Mike (Growth): +1. we should surface a clear tradeoff curve so PMs can pick by SLA vs cost. also need 1 short headline for the slide and 2 CTAs for the demo funnel.
Jordan (Product): agree. headline options: "Choose predictable latency or lower unit cost" vs "Latency-first vs cost-first: a playbook". prefer the latter for product teams.
Anya (Design): I can mock 2 layout options tomorrow. prefer a single multi-line slide that walks left-to-right: low-latency/high-cost -> middle -> high-cost-savings/latency tail. will do 3 small charts + one hero stat.
Deepak (ML): for charts, use p50/p95/p99 lines (p95 is primary). source is recent perf runs (region us-west2, 64-token prompts, batch=auto). quick config to generate plot:```chart:
  x: latency_ms
  y: cost_per_1k_tokens
  series: [redwood-opt-1.3b-q, open-7b-8bit, redwood-14b-flash]
  agg: p95
  filter: region==\"us-west2\" and prompt_len<80
```This will show the slopes we expect.
Tia (Sales): add a second slide with routing playbook: "If p95 < 120ms use fastpath; else route to cost-optimized model with fallback". Also add a 1-liner for enterprise buyers about SLA-backed Dedicated.
Mike (Growth): for inbound routing, we need clear trigger copy for the demo CTA. e.g., "See how your SLA maps to monthly tokens cost" — that links to an interactive estimator.
Sara (Marketing): perfect. action items: Anya mockups (tomorrow), Deepak export p95 lines + csv (EOD), Jordan + Mike craft 2 headline/CTA variants, Tia assemble enterprise note. I’ll draft the webinar blurb once visuals land. :memo:
Anya (Design): quick Q — want raw axes labels (ms, $/1k) or convert to normalized score for non-technical audience?
Jordan (Product): keep real units on the main slide, but include a simplified normalized legend on the handout slide.
Deepak (ML): exporting now. will include a small table of assumptions (sequence len, batch, quantization). sample assumptions line: "14b-flash q4: 4-bit, KV cache enabled, batch_auto=on"
webinar-bot: Reminder: draft due in 48h for slides review.
Tia (Sales): for messaging iteration, can we run A/B: "Predictable latency, predictable cost" vs "Optimize for dollars or milliseconds" across a small pilot list? Mike can spin up.
Mike (Growth): yes, will run to top 2 segments: platform engineers and product managers. plan: 1-week test post-webinar.
Sara (Marketing): great. keeping this thread as single source of truth. I'll post the initial slide copy when Anya uploads mocks. Thanks all :rocket:
